svg.title: Jay Malhotra, AI/ML engineer
svg.desc: I build AI products, and the checks that decide what they are allowed to say and do. Founding engineer at Ayebot. Master of Management Analytics at McGill University, Montreal. Recent work: AsOf for IBM Db2Hack 2026, SkillGuard for the Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon, Perfect Pair (prize winner, BSRM x ALDO Retail Gen AI Hackathon), Ayebot (in production).
